description: This file defines the TalkModeRuntime actor in Swift, managing speech recognition, text-to-speech, and voice interaction logic for a macOS app. It handles audio input, speech recognition tasks, TTS playback via ElevenLabs and system voices, configuration reloading, and interaction control such as enabling/disabling and pausing. The code interacts with AVFoundation, Speech framework, custom UI controllers, and external services to facilitate a voice-enabled communication mode.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntime
classes.description: An actor class that manages voice recognition, speech synthesis, and interaction state for macOS. It handles enabling/disabling, pausing, speech recognition tasks, TTS playback with fallbacks, config reloading, and interaction control mechanisms.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk runtime, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the voice recognition process, updating UI state.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and begins the speech recognition process with audio input setup.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech recognition and releases related resources.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition result updates, manages transcript data, and determines if recognition should be interrupted or finalized.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Starts a background task to monitor silence and trigger final transcript submission.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if sufficient silence has elapsed to finalize current speech input.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Completes the current transcript and triggers TTS and response handling.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Sends the transcript to a chat service and processes the assistant's reply for TTS playback.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt message to send, incorporating any interruption points.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for the assistant's reply text post-request.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Plays the assistant's reply text via TTS, with fallback options (ElevenLabs or system voice).

methods.name: playSystemVoice
methods.description: Speaks text using the system voice synthesizer.

methods.name: resolveVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves the preferred voice ID, fetching from external API if needed.

methods.name: resolveVoiceAlias
methods.description: Resolves voice alias to a valid voice ID.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech playback, handling both PCM and MP3 formats, updating the phase accordingly.
